title: Farthest-cell triplet entropy: high-dimensional shell limits and hyperbolic curvature amplification
summary: We introduce farthest-cell triplet entropy, the conditional Shannon entropy of the farthest-prototype label given three random prototypes. For independent queries and prototypes, its estimator records only the farthest label, not coordinates or numerical distances. The statistic is bounded by $\log 3$, is invariant under common strictly increasing transformations of the dissimilarities, and has an exact mutual-information interpretation.
